title: Cast Settings
description: Cast-wide settings for a character bible (cast/cast.yaml): where the style line comes from, the no-text clause, which models draw the bible and the scenes, and which reference images go into each shot. Every key is optional; lib/character_bible.py fills in defaults. See skills/meta/character-bible.md.

source.description: playbook = use the channel playbook's asset_generation.image_prompt_prefix; inline = use line.

no_text_clause.description: Appended to every prompt. Reference models take no negative prompt, so text bans are written as plain instructions.

sheet_background.description: Background for bible reference images (master, turnaround, outfits, poses, expressions).

reference.description: Reference-conditioned model for character shots and every bible job after the master.

reference_fallback.description: Used only after the user approves the switch.

master.description: Text-to-image model for master candidates (flux_image model name).

plates.description: Text-to-image model for shots with no bible character.

identity.description: Which identity image(s) every shot attaches per character.

pose_image.description: When to attach an approved pose image (the pose text is always included).

expression_image.description: When to attach an approved expression image (the expression text is always included).
